text: Saputo Inc. (TSE: SAP) is controlled by the Saputo family: per Saputo's own 2024 Management Information Circular, Emanuele (Lino) Saputo held 137,728,100 common shares (32% of the class) as of 31 May 2024, including 131,122,119 shares held directly by Jolina Capital Inc., a holding company he controls. Quebec's public pension fund, CDPQ, separately holds a minority stake, which per CDPQ's own press release increased to approximately 4.5% following a September 2024 purchase.

source.name: La Caisse (CDPQ): CDPQ increases its stake in Saputo Inc.
source.quote: CDPQ's stake in the company now totals approximatively 4.5%, following the acquisition of 13.5 million shares at a price of $27.96 per share.
